title: The change router's once-per-session marker survives /compact and /clear, so a later change request after compaction gets no routing
goal: A SessionStart hook with matcher compact|clear removes that session's _cache/change_router marker (or the marker key changes on compaction), so the first change request after /compact is routed again; test_change_router plants the reset

run: import json,sys; s=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json'))['hooks'].get('SessionStart',[]); sys.exit(not any('change_router' in h.get('command','') for m in s for h in m.get('hooks',[])))
